::: {#exr-valid-arguments}
#### Which conclusions are safe?

Let $P$ be "the tests pass", $Q$ be "the build is deployed"
and $R$ be "the build is rolled back".
In each argument below, the propositions before "so" are its premises,
and the one after is its conclusion.
For each argument, decide whether the conclusion must be true
whenever all of the premises are true.

1. $P \Rightarrow Q$ and $P$, so $Q$.
2. $P \Rightarrow Q$ and $Q$, so $P$.
3. $P \Rightarrow Q$ and $\neg Q$, so $\neg P$.
4. $P \lor R$ and $\neg R$, so $P$.

:::
